confidence_notes: Food anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living index results found in a web search (Numbeo, Citycost Oct 2026, MyLifeElsewhere). Those sources put an inexpensive meal at about RM15, a cappuccino at about RM12, a domestic draft beer at about RM17 and a three-course mid-range meal for two at about RM80. They were converted at roughly 4.1 MYR per USD. Malaysia taxes alcohol heavily. Cocktail and wine prices were not searched directly; they are estimated from the local beer price plus typical Penang bar markups, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of George Town's hostel and hotel market for mid-2026. They were not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang (George Town) is similar to Malacca and a bit cheaper than Kuala Lumpur for food and lodging. Alcohol is priced higher than in Thai or Vietnamese cities because of Malaysian excise duty.
